verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents control owners with owner-filtered roadmap views, assignable tasks and action items, and evidence requests that carry comments, attachments and status updates. These give manual evidence some ownership and workflow. Reminders are documented only for access reviews tied to policy timelines, not for manual evidence artifacts generally. Missing for 10: due dates on manual evidence items, renewal reminders for manual artifacts, expiry/staleness tracking per artifact, owner assignment at the artifact level rather than the control level, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
